title: Violent Playground
creator: Basil Dearden
description: Director Basil Dearden’s drama about a Liverpool policeman, played by Stanley Baker, moved to youth work and up against a teenage arsonist played by David McCallum. It was shot around Gerard Gardens, inner-city council tenements since demolished.

title: Dockers
creator: Bill Anderson
description: Television film about the Liverpool dock strike of 1995–98, when some 500 dockers were sacked after refusing to cross a picket line. Writers Jimmy McGovern and Irvine Welsh made it with the sacked men, whose pickets stood at the Royal Seaforth Dock gates.

title: Bread
creator: Carla Lane
description: Writer Carla Lane’s BBC sitcom, 1986–91, about the Boswells, a big Catholic family in the Dingle, a working-class district by the south docks, getting by on the dole and small scams in Thatcher’s Britain, all under their mother Nellie’s rule.
